cohort: The study included 242 pregnant women referred to Fatemieh Educational and Medical Center in Hamadan, Iran.
finding: The study found no statistically significant difference in women's satisfaction with childbirth between deliveries with spinal analgesia and routine deliveries without analgesia.
mod_finding: No statistically significant difference in women's satisfaction with childbirth was found between deliveries with spinal analgesia and routine deliveries without analgesia.
cross-section timing: Data was collected two hours after delivery until the mother was discharged from the hospital.
